name: jiska
biography: Jiska has a M.Sc. in IT-Security. She is a PhD student at the Secure Mobile Networking Lab (TU Darmstadt) since May 2014. Her main research interest are wireless physical layer security and reverse engineering. You might also know her embroidery projects or game shows from past CCC events. Twitter: @seemoolab
